Header: Spodoptera frugiperda In Sinhala: Sena dalambuwa Tamil: Padai pulu

Prevention: Avoid staggered planting/ late planting or off-season planting
Avoid planting new crop near infested fields
Use of recommended fertilizer/avoid use of excessive amounts of nitrogen fertilizer
Encourage biocontrol agents such as ants, ladybird beetles, birds, parasitoids ( Telenomus spp), by providing shelter, flowering plants and by minimizing application of broad spectrum pesticides
Monitoring: Look for large ragged and elongated holes on the leaves
Look for larger larvae showing inverted
Y-shaped marking on the front and four dark spots forming a square on the second to last body segment
Observe for moist sawdust-like frass near the whorl and upper leaves
Direct Control: Handpick and destroy egg masses and caterpillars
Apply sand or ash into the whorl
Apply neem seed kernel extract 300-500g/ 10 l water
Restrictions: Always wear personal protective equipment while handling pesticidess
Do not repeat insecticides having same mode of action (MOA)
MOA insecticides to maximum of 2 applications per season
Mainly act by ingestion/ has contact action too.
